method: Equal-weight arithmetic component mean of 28 NOAA LOOFS surface sigma-layer-0 nowcasts sampled every six hours over the full calendar week 12–18 October 2026 (UTC). Actual selected model times run 12 October 00:00 through 18 October 18:00 UTC; week boundaries are 12 October 00:00 inclusive to 19 October 00:00 exclusive. This is a seven-calendar-day sampled mean, not a continuous 168-hour integral, climatology or observed current/temperature map. Eastward and northward face velocities averaged separately; node temperatures averaged separately. Every retained value has all 28 valid source samples. No synthetic current/temperature fill, extrapolation, spatial remapping or river-model changes.
